Package model.vehicles

Klasse VehicleManager

java.lang.Object
model.vehicles.VehicleManager
public class VehicleManager extends Object
Manages all vehicles information and interaction related to vehicles in SUMO via TraCI interface

This class retrieves and stores all of the information related to all vehicles at each step (speed, color) and also helps inject vehicles into SUMO It stores simulation state at every step().

Autor:
Minh Khoi

  • Methodendetails

    • step

      public void step()
      Synchronizes the local vehicle data with the current state of the simulation.

      This method performs the following actions:

      1. Retrieves the list of all active vehicle IDs from SUMO.
      2. Resets the local data storage.
      3. Calls updateVehiclesInfo() to fetch detailed attributes for each vehicle.
      If the connection is lost or closed, the method handles the exception and clears the local list of vehicles.

    • injectVehicle

      public void injectVehicle(String vehicleId, String typeId, String routeId, de.tudresden.sumo.objects.SumoColor sumoColor, double Speed)
      Injects a new vehicle into the simulation dynamically.
      Parameter:
      vehicleId - The unique identifier for the new vehicle.
      typeId - The vehicle type ID (must be defined in the SUMO config/routes).
      routeId - The route ID (must be defined in the SUMO config/routes).
      sumoColor - The color of the vehicle.
      Speed - The initial speed of the vehicle in m/s.
